items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Well, yeah, I knew Duke well. Go out there and you'll see a picture Duke set up for me and said some nice things on it.

ctx.x: What about some of the events at the union? I know maybe some of these things are hard to remember. See, you've done so much, I think that's just like somebody that's travelled to every city in the world and somebody would say which one did you like the best and it's pretty hard. But you know, at the union on Central, right? Weren't there ever any big bands rehearsing there or you know, if you think back, you know, did Duke Ellington come there or Jimmie Lunceford, just to rehearse?
Yeah, well, see we want to know about things like this.

items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You didn't work with the King?

ctx.x: No, no, no. Uh-uh. Somebody got that wrong.
You didn't work with the King?
